passage: For three years, a team of biologists studied the ______ a small, scaly mammal found in parts of Africa and Asia that feeds mainly on ants and termites.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: "a small, scaly mammal…" is a description that renames "pangolin."
A renaming phrase at the end of a sentence is set off with a comma.
A semicolon or period would leave the description as a fragment; no punctuation runs it in incorrectly.
key: An appositive that renames a noun is set off with a comma.
